title: Lost Mary BM600 Guava Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Guava Ice Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods pair tropical Guava with a cooling finish. Sweet, fragrant Guava carries through the inhale, while a frosty exhale keeps the flavour light and refreshing. Each pack includes two 2ml pods prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, offering up to 600 puffs per pod depending on use. The smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw ensures a consistent and satisfying vape without refilling or coil replacements. Designed for the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these pods install easily: simply click one into place and enjoy a tropical vape with a cool edge.
